source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR2 requires six-cell gate unit coverage plus CONFLICT/no-write, PASS/write, evidence-race retry, CLI gate-mode, telemetry, and workflow evidence tests grounded in the actual writer diff.
## SUCCESS
Add only missing tests/fixtures needed to prove the contract; do not duplicate adequate writer coverage.
## SCOPE
Executor workspace tests under packages/service-knowledge and test-only helpers if unavoidable.
## NON_GOALS
No production behavior changes, unrelated coverage, or external repo edits.
## CONSTRAINTS
Test-first against actual diff; preserve api-gateway golden fixture; SCRUTINY: high.
## VALIDATION
Targeted pytest commands are named and all new tests fail without the gate behavior.
## OUTPUT
Committed test diff or explicit no-change evidence plus exact commands.
source.title: test-engineer: complete reconcile gate coverage
